title: user.merged
description: Two accounts became one (stapel-auth 0.30.0): from_user_id ceased to exist and every row that named it belongs to into_user_id now. This module re-points its PromptLog rows onto the survivor and keeps them whole — a prompt log row carries metering the deployment already paid for, so nothing is summed or dropped. Idempotent: the second delivery re-points 0 rows.
